summary: Rio Tinto plc and Rio Tinto Limited filed a Form 6-K with routine exhibits including voting rights, share issuances, substantial holder notices, PDMR shareholdings, a dividend notification, half-year results slides, and a media release about a proposed sale of a desalination plant to Yindjibarndi WaterCo. None of these items constitute a special-situation event; the desalination sale is not detailed and appears minor. The filing is a standard periodic report under Rule 13a-16 with no transactional terms or strategic actions that would trigger a special-situations classification.
